layers.comment: Named "October crust"; note "remnants of October crust". Basal layer drawn with DH glyph, 5.0 mm. Bar rendered red/salmon in chart (layer highlighted by observer).
Chart size "2.0-3.0(2.0-3.0)": FC 2.0-3.0 mm with secondary DH 2.0-3.0 mm.
Glyph drawn as inverted A (Propagation Labs rime symbol); header surface grain is Rime 1.0 mm. Classed PP (rimed precipitation particles, PPrm).

summary: 85 cm HS: 12 cm basal DH (4F, "remnants of October crust"), 58 cm FC/DH (4F-, 2-3 mm) and 15 cm rimed PP (F) on top; CTN x2 (no failure); temperature profile from -1.2 degC at ground to -6.2 degC at surface.
reading_issues: Header coordinates (51.7480,-116.5150) and elevation (6168 ft = 1880 m) do NOT match the Bow Summit study plot (~2040 m, 51.709,-116.479): about 5 km away and ~160 m lower, different observer (Aaron Beardmore), profile named "Bow Summit Profile - 2025-02-01". Filed as bow-summit-plot because of the folder/filename, but it may not be the plot itself. Surface grain in header is "Rime 1.0mm" and top layer glyph (inverted A) read as rime; surface_grain stored as PP (rime = PPrm; the TRANSCRIBE class list has no separate rime class) with the raw header text kept in header_other. CTN label drawn at the top of the chart; no failure height. Temperature dots read against the top axis (0 at left, 128.3 px per degC), heights against the left axis.
